mapper.select: SELECT r.gb_ai_wr_id AS workflowRunId, r.gb_ai_wr_workflow_id AS workflowId, w.gb_ai_workflow_code AS workflowCode, w.gb_ai_workflow_name AS workflowName, r.gb_ai_wr_advisor_id AS advisorId, r.gb_ai_wr_user_id AS userId, r.gb_ai_wr_status AS status, r.gb_ai_wr_result_summary AS resultSummary, r.gb_ai_wr_error_message AS errorMessage, r.gb_ai_wr_create_time AS createTime, r.gb_ai_wr_update_time AS updateTime FROM gb_ai_workflow_run r INNER JOIN gb_ai_workflow w ON w.gb_ai_workflow_id = r.gb_ai_wr_workflow_id WHERE r.gb_ai_wr_advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.gb_ai_wr_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.gb_ai_wr_create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
